conventions.weight: integer when the source weight is a constant; null when it is a function of party/wave state (see weight_note). max_weight is the declared cap (WeightedModifierType 3rd ctor arg) when present.
conventions.weight_note_shorthand: wave = globalScene.currentBattle.waveIndex; 'classic' = classic game mode; counts of party members are always capped at 3 unless stated
conventions.zero_weight_meaning: entries whose computed weight is 0 are excluded from the tier's threshold table for that roll (index ignored)
conventions.max_stack_zeroing: at threshold build time, any entry whose modifier already exists at max stack count gets weight 0, EXCEPT PokemonHeldItemModifierType and FormChangeItemModifierType entries (regenerateModifierPoolThresholds)

COMMON.weight_note: 6, but 0 in classic when pokeball count >= MAX_PER_TYPE_POKEBALLS
3 * min(3, party members with >=10 HP lost, HP ratio <= 0.875, not fainted)
1 * min(3, party members with >=25 HP lost, HP ratio <= 0.75, not fainted)
3 * min(3, alive members without a Leppa berry that have a move with >half PP used and <=5 PP left)
2, but 0 on classic wave 199 or if an active 10-battle lure still has >=60% duration left (lureWeightFunc(10, 2))

GREAT.weight_note: 6, but 0 in classic at max Great Balls
6 * min(3, alive members with a status not already covered by a held Toxic/Flame Orb of the same status)
1 if fainted members >= ceil(party size / 2), else 0
3 * min(3, members with >=100 HP lost, HP ratio <= 0.625, not fainted)
1 * min(3, members with >=100 HP lost, HP ratio <= 0.5, not fainted)
floor((min(3, MAX_POTION-style HP count) + FULL_HEAL-style status count) / 2)
4, lureWeightFunc(15, 4) - 0 on classic wave 199 or active 15-battle lure with >=60% left
1 if any party member is not Terapagos/Ogerpon/Shedinja, else 0
requires >=2 unfused members; 4 in Spliced-Only mode; 2 in classic during a fusion-boost event; else 0
0 in daily mode; else max(1 - rerollCount, 0)

ULTRA.weight_note: 15, but 0 in classic at max Ultra Balls
10 if (daily mode OR (Eviolite unlocked AND not fresh-start challenge)) AND some non-G-Max member whose species (or fusion species) can still evolve and is not already holding an Eviolite; else 0
12 if a party member (or fusion) is Farfetch'd/Galarian Farfetch'd/Sirfetch'd without a Leek; else 0
10 if a member not holding either orb can be badly poisoned and has Toxic Boost/Poison Heal, or (Quick Feet/Guts/Marvel Scale/Magic Guard without Flare Boost), or Facade/Psycho Shift; else 0
10, mirror of TOXIC_ORB for burn (Flare Boost specific; Toxic Boost/Poison Heal treated as opposite)
10 if a member below max Mystical Rock stack has a weather/terrain-setting ability (Drought, Drizzle, Sand Stream, etc.) or move (Sunny Day, Rain Dance, terrain moves, etc.); else 0

ROGUE.weight_note: 16, but 0 in classic at max Rogue Balls
0 in daily mode; else max(3 - rerollCount, 0)

MASTER.weight_note: 24, but 0 in classic at max Master Balls
0 in daily/endless/spliced-only modes; else max(5 - 2 * rerollCount, 0)
24 if NOT (classic with fusion-boost event) AND NOT spliced-only AND >=2 unfused members; else 0
1 if daily mode OR (Mini Black Hole unlocked AND not fresh-start challenge); else 0

tier_rolling.base_roll: tierValue = randSeedInt(1024) (uniform 0..1023), rolled independently per option slot

luck_upgrades.applies: PLAYER pool only, and only when tierValue != 0 (a natural MASTER roll never upgrade-rolls) and allowLuckUpgrades
luck_upgrades.upgrade_odds: upgradeOdds = floor(128 / ((partyLuck + 4) / 4)); per-roll upgrade chance = 4 / upgradeOdds
luck_upgrades.chaining: do-while: each successful upgrade roll increments upgradeCount and rolls again, so multiple tier jumps are possible
luck_upgrades.tier_clamp: tier += upgradeCount, then decremented while the pool has no entries at that tier (upgradeCount decremented alongside)
luck_upgrades.fixed_tier_variant: when a tier is forced (tier-lock / guaranteed tiers) and tier < MASTER, a while-loop rolls the same 4/upgradeOdds per step to climb one tier at a time, stopping on first failure

party_luck.formula: sum over battle-allowed party members of pokemon.getLuck() (= luck + fusionLuck; per-mon luck is shiny-variant based, 0 for non-shiny), clamped to 0..14; timed-event boosts can add; daily runs use a seeded random 0..14 instead
party_luck.display_scale: 0..14 maps to grades D through SSS

tier_rolling.duplicate_retry: per option: retryCount = min(count * 5, 50); candidate rerolled while its name or item group matches an already-generated option (or fails a challenge check); tier and upgradeCount are preserved across retries
tier_rolling.generator_retry: if a ModifierTypeGenerator returns null (no valid target), reroll within same tier; after 100 failed retries drop one tier

options_count.modifiers: ExtraModifierModifier (GOLDEN_POKEBALL 'Golden Pokeball') and TempExtraModifierModifier (SILVER_POKEBALL, lasts 100 waves) each add +1 option per stack
options_count.wave_scaling: none - count does not scale with wave
options_count.custom_override: CustomModifierSettings (guaranteed tiers/options/funcs) overrides the count; fillRemaining pads back up to the normal count

reroll.cost_formula: cost = ceil(wave / 10) * baseValue * 2^rerollCount * multiplier, where baseValue = 250 normally
reroll.tier_locked_base: with Lock Capsule tier-lock active, baseValue = sum over the current options of tierValues[tier], tierValues = [50, 125, 300, 750, 2000] for COMMON/GREAT/ULTRA/ROGUE/MASTER
reroll.doubling: 2^rerollCount - doubles with every reroll taken this shop screen
reroll.modifiers: HealShopCostModifier (Black Sludge) multiplies the final cost; WAIVE_ROLL_FEE override makes it 0; customModifierSettings.rerollMultiplier scales it, negative value disables rerolling (-1)
reroll.reroll_effect: rerollCount is also passed into weight functions (VOUCHER/VOUCHER_PLUS/VOUCHER_PREMIUM decay per reroll); pool thresholds are regenerated each reroll

shop.availability: shop present only when wave % 10 != 0 (no shop on x0 boss waves)
shop.base_cost: baseCost = getWaveMoneyAmount(1): with W = ceil(wave/10) - 1, moneyValue = ((W + 1 + (0.75 + (((wave-1) % 10) + 1) / 10)) * 100) ^ (1 + 0.005 * W); cost = floor(moneyValue / 10) * 10
shop.rows_unlocked_formula: rows shown = first ceil(max(wave + 10, 0) / 30) of the 7 row groups below (so row N unlocks at wave 30*(N-1) - 9, i.e. waves 1 / 21 / 51 / 81 / 111 / 141 / 171)
shop.price: item price = baseCost * cost_multiplier, then HealShopCostModifier (Black Sludge) applies; prices are fixed per item, not rolled

wild_vs_trainer_pools.purpose: IMPORTANT: WILD and TRAINER pools are NOT used for the player's post-battle pick. The player reward pick ALWAYS draws from the PLAYER pool (SelectModifierPhase.getPoolType() returns PLAYER unconditionally). WILD/TRAINER pools generate HELD ITEMS placed on ENEMY Pokemon when a wave spawns (battle type TRAINER -> trainerModifierPool, else wildModifierPool); the player only obtains these by stealing (Grip Claw/Thief) or catching the holder.
wild_vs_trainer_pools.enemy_item_rolling: same 1024-based tier thresholds, but no luck upgrades (player-only); instead getEnemyModifierTypesForWave passes upgradeChance: a flat 1-in-upgradeChance roll grants +1 tier (base 32; boss 16; final boss divides by a further 8). Item count per enemy = successes over gameMode.getEnemyModifierChance rolls; bosses get at least half; wave % 1000 == 0 adds a guaranteed MINI_BLACK_HOLE

notes: ModifierPoolType enum: PLAYER, WILD, TRAINER, ENEMY_BUFF, DAILY_STARTER. ENEMY_BUFF is the Endless-mode enemy team buff pool; DAILY_STARTER seeds daily-run starter held items. Neither affects the post-battle player pick.
ModifierTier enum: COMMON, GREAT, ULTRA, ROGUE, MASTER, LUXURY. LUXURY has no pool; it is only a display tier.

Weight selection within a tier: weights are summed into cumulative thresholds (regenerateModifierPoolThresholds), then value = randSeedInt(totalWeight) picks the first threshold > value. Zero-weight entries are excluded from that roll.
Thresholds are regenerated per shop screen and per reroll with the live party and rerollCount, so conditional weights are evaluated fresh each time.
Non-stackable items already owned at max stacks are weight-0'd at threshold build time (held-item and form-change generators exempt because they target individual Pokemon).

Generators (BERRY, TM_*, EVOLUTION_ITEM, ATTACK_TYPE_BOOSTER, BASE_STAT_BOOSTER, MINT, TERA_SHARD, FORM_CHANGE_ITEM, SPECIES_STAT_BOOSTER, etc.) roll their concrete sub-item after the pool entry is selected; sub-item selection logic lives in each generator in modifier-type.ts and is not captured here.
The free pick can be skipped; picking transfers control via applyChosenModifier. Overrides (ITEM_REWARD_OVERRIDE) can replace rolled options in dev builds.
LUCKY_EGG boost value is 40 (%); GOLDEN_EGG is the wild MASTER-tier drop.
Money reward for a wave uses the same getWaveMoneyAmount with different multipliers; shop baseCost uses multiplier 1.
unresolved: Per-Pokemon luck initialization: getLuck() = this.luck + fusionLuck was verified, but the assignment of this.luck (commonly shiny ? variant + 1 : 0) was not directly read from the constructor in this pass.
Exact sub-item weighting inside ModifierTypeGenerators (e.g. which berry, which TM, tera-shard type odds) was out of scope and not extracted.
gameMode.getEnemyModifierChance values (denominator for enemy held-item count rolls) were not read from game-mode.ts.
Timed-event luck boosts (getEventLuckBoost, event luck-boosted species) depend on live event config, not source constants.
